d: "We'll be cursed for what we did that day! The Emperor was Mad! What was he thinking? He'll bring the Gods down on all of us! Just because that one Priestess would not sleep with him. Damned! He had to kill them all. Why? And that was not the worst part. All of the Vestal Virgin Priestesses were all really virgins. I know you are shocked. So were we. We checked. We took turns in shifts... Making them eligible for the knife. As it was then as it is today no virgin can be executed. Each one of the Priestesses had so be raped. Many resisted, It was either that or face what the Mad Emperor would do to us if we didn't. It was a heavy task. I still can't get their screams and weeping out of my mind to this day. Then we did the deed. We took them to the temple steps and started sawing. Yes, we sawed through their necks with our German fighting knives. There were so many we had to take turns with that also. This will damn the Empire... We are all cursed now."
